1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000020_ERENVILLE
1.description: Apologies for the wait. I hope I haven't called you away from anything important.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000030_ERENVILLE
2.description: I chanced upon some commissioned items at my destination, so I thought I might deliver them.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000040_GRAHATIA
3.description: Where did you go, if I may ask?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000060_KRILE
5.description: You went to Tural!? Then the person who you wished to introduce...

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000070_ERENVILLE
6.description: Aye, she hails from there. I present to you...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000110_WUKLAMAT
10.description: (-Exuberant Newcomer-)Sorry, sorry! It's just so different here─I can't help but want to explore!

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000120_ERENVILLE
11.description: Well, while you were exploring, your candidate came to us.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000130_ERENVILLE
12.description: This is <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>. The adventurer you crossed the seas to meet.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000140_WUKLAMAT
13.description: (-Exuberant Newcomer-)Ooh... You weren't exaggerating. It's plain <hex:020810E905FF067368652773FF056865277303> no ordinary <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000150_WUKLAMAT
14.description: I'm Wuk Lamat. Claimant to the throne of Tuliyollal.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000170_ERENVILLE
16.description: It's Tural's governing nation. The capital bears the same name.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000180_WUKLAMAT
17.description: I'll get to the point. I want you to come with me to my homeland.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000190_ERENVILLE
18.description: Given the magnitude of the request, perhaps you should explain why you're making it.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000210_WUKLAMAT
20.description: Soon an event of great import will be held in Tural: the rite of succession.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000220_WUKLAMAT
21.description: Taking the form of a contest, it will determine who next ascends the throne.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000230_WUKLAMAT
22.description: As daughter to its present keeper, I will participate─and I have every intention of winning.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000240_WUKLAMAT
23.description: I was searching for champions to join me when Erenville told me about you.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000250_WUKLAMAT
24.description: A mighty warrior who knows no fear! Who sweeps aside terrible fiends as if they were reeds! Who flew to the edge of existence and saved our star!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000260_ERENVILLE
25.description: She asked who Eorzea's greatest hero was, and so I told her. Much more elegantly, I might add.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000270_WUKLAMAT
26.description: Now you know why. You'll come to Tural, yes?

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000290_GRAHATIA
28.description: Wuk Lamat, was it? You claim to be of the royal family, but is it not the Mamool Ja who rule in Tural?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000300_WUKLAMAT
29.description: Tuliyollal is a nation of many peoples. Not only the Mamool Ja as some across the seas are quick to assume.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000310_WUKLAMAT
30.description: That said, its present ruler is a Mamool Ja, and one blessed with two heads besides.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000320_WUKLAMAT
31.description: He's also my father. Not by blood, obviously, but he raised me as his own, and that's what matters.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000330_GRAHATIA
32.description: So that is the way of it... My apologies if I was indelicate.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000340_WUKLAMAT
33.description: Hardly! I know little about your land, and nothing about your parentage.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000350_WUKLAMAT
34.description: Ah, but in my eagerness I've gotten ahead of myself. I can't expect you to agree on the spot when we've only just met.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000360_WUKLAMAT
35.description: If you have any questions, I'll do my best to answer them. Just know, though, that if it's adventure you seek, you could do far worse than come with me.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000370_WUKLAMAT
36.description: Now, this is only a rumor...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000380_WUKLAMAT
37.description: But apparently, the contest will involve the fabled city of gold and the legendary beast Valigarmanda.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000390_WUKLAMAT
38.description: Tell me that doesn't pique your interest.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
41.description: This is strictly a rumor, nothing more?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
42.description: Golden city... I've heard about it before.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000400_WUKLAMAT
43.description: We're going to get along, you and I!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000410_WUKLAMAT
44.description: Tural has no shortage of unexplored frontiers and deadly fiends. You'll never want for excitement, I promise you!

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000420_WUKLAMAT
45.description: Well, the details of the contest have yet to be announced.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000430_WUKLAMAT
46.description: But the rumors come from someone involved in the preparations, so I'd say there's more than a grain of truth to them.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000440_WUKLAMAT
47.description: So the tales have reached even these shores! I can't help but feel proud!

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000450_ERENVILLE
48.description: I advise you not to put much store by these rumors. Golden cities are naught but a dreamer's fancy.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000460_WUKLAMAT
49.description: Says the dreamer who was bent on finding one when he was a child. Just because you failed doesn't mean it doesn't exist.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000470_KRILE
50.description: Tuliyollal and the golden city... Just like in the letter to Grandfather.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000480_WUKLAMAT
51.description: Regardless of what the contest may entail, it'll be no simple thing. If I'm to triumph, I'll need capable and dependable companions.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000490_WUKLAMAT
52.description: So let's go on a hunt together! There's no better way to get acquainted!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000510_WUKLAMAT
54.description: So much ice... It rivals even Yok Tural.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000520_WUKLAMAT
55.description: Ooh, a white bear! I wonder what it tastes like...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000530_ERENVILLE
56.description: Remember, we're here to deal with creatures that have been deemed an unacceptable danger. Do not attack anything else unprovoked.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000550_WUKLAMAT
58.description: So this is the isle where aether literally bursts forth!

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000560_ERENVILLE
59.description: Aye, the Isle of Haam. The geysers lie deep inland, however.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000570_WUKLAMAT
60.description: You really are knowledgeable. Koana told me nothing about this place.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000580_ERENVILLE
61.description: I doubt your brother managed to come out this way. He's like to have toured facilities like Labyrinthos, however.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000590_WUKLAMAT
62.description: The great big cavern under the city? It's amazing that they could make a sky down there, complete with a sun.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000600_GRAHATIA
63.description: This brother of yours... He has been to Sharlayan?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000610_WUKLAMAT
64.description: He has. Koana's my second older brother, and until recently, he was a student in the city.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000620_WUKLAMAT
65.description: He went on and on about “technological amusements.” It made me want to come here too one day.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000630_WUKLAMAT
66.description: And so I did. I think I understood something of how he felt when I set foot in his beloved Studium.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000640_GRAHATIA
67.description: He went to the Studium? Your brother must be quite a scholar.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000650_GRAHATIA
68.description: But I wonder... Like you, he'd be royalty, yes? Such a personage coming to Sharlayan to receive an education would surely have caused a stir, yet I recall nothing of the sort...

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000660_WUKLAMAT
69.description: He consulted with the head of the Studium beforehand, that his identity might remain secret.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000670_WUKLAMAT
70.description: Being Miqo'te, he had no trouble blending in. He's adopted like me, you see.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000680_WUKLAMAT
71.description: One time, though, he almost let it slip to a professor. It was all he could do to parry the barrage of questions.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000690_GRAHATIA
72.description: Having no shortage of questions myself, I can imagine.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000700_WUKLAMAT
73.description: Ask whatever you like. I don't mind. But I maintain hunting together is the best way to get to know someone.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000710_ERENVILLE
74.description: The researchers should be up ahead. Let's find them and learn what we can.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000720_WUKLAMAT
75.description: Powerful wings and razor-sharp talons... Worthy prey!

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000740_GIANTCOLIBRI
77.description: Squawk! What is that thing!? What is that thing!?

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000780_ERENVILLE
81.description: I'll stay with the researchers. The creature, I leave to you.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000810_WUKLAMAT
84.description: Just so we're clear, I wasn't startled by the beast earlier. It caught me by surprise, that's all.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000820_GRAHATIA
85.description: Forgive me, but I fail to see a difference.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000830_WUKLAMAT
86.description: I-I'm getting hungry. Let's be done with this so we can eat!

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000840_GIANTCOLIBRI
87.description: Caught me by surprise! Caught me by surprise!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000850_WUKLAMAT
88.description: Think you're clever, huh? I'll rip off that beak and roast you on a spit!

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000860_WUKLAMAT
89.description: Hmph, and I had barely limbered up.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000880_GRAHATIA
91.description: It was a terrible foe, but no match for your axe.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000900_WUKLAMAT
93.description: You were pretty impressive yourselves. I was right to invite you on a hunt.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000910_WUKLAMAT
94.description: But what a curious bird that was. Though we have similar in Tural, they don't grow so big or use such dirty tricks.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000930_WUKLAMAT
96.description: Aye, dirty and despicable. Otherwise I could have...easily...

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000970_KRILE
100.description: I am terribly, terribly sorry to have kept you all waiting!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000980_ERENVILLE
101.description: She arrived as I was seeing the researchers to safety. It was all I could do to keep up with her after I explained what happened.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_000990_GRAHATIA
102.description: So this is what you meant by seeing to preparations.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001000_KRILE
103.description: After hearing of the contest, I thought how wonderful it would be to join you.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001010_KRILE
104.description: In coming here, I wanted to demonstrate my skill at arms to Wuk Lamat. Alas, it seems I missed most of the action...

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001030_WUKLAMAT
106.description: That was amazing! The beast didn't stand a chance!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001040_KRILE
107.description: I'm glad to have been of service.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001050_GRAHATIA
108.description: May I ask what inspired this change?

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001060_KRILE
109.description: You will recall the time you descended to the aetherial sea in search of Hydaelyn.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001070_KRILE
110.description: Recognizing that my skills were inadequate, I chose to provide support from afar rather than join you.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001080_KRILE
111.description: It was the same when you set forth for Ultima Thule. How it pained me to stay behind, again and again...

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001090_KRILE
112.description: That's what inspired this change. Ever since the Final Days were averted, I've used every spare moment to hone my craft.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001100_KRILE
113.description: As you all have adapted your methods to suit the circumstances, I started by considering how I might best contribute.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001110_KRILE
114.description: And after much deliberation, I arrived at my answer...

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001120_KRILE
115.description: With the esoteric art passed down by the legendary Archon Relm─pictomancy.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001130_KRILE
116.description: As I recall, you have embraced versatility to effectively complement a certain someone's style.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001140_KRILE
117.description: What I do is much the same. Like you, I don't want to be left behind.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001160_GRAHATIA
119.description: I must say, you appear to be especially keen on being involved in the ritual of succession. Is there any particular reason?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001170_KRILE
120.description: Yes, there is. This letter from Tuliyollal.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001180_KRILE
121.description: It was addressed to my grandfather Galuf, and turned up among the Students' archives.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001190_KRILE
122.description: The ink was faded so I couldn't fully make out the sender's name, a Gulool...someone.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001200_WUKLAMAT
123.description: Ja Ja. Gulool Ja Ja. That's my father, the Dawnservant.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001220_KRILE
125.description: While much of it isn't legible, it appears to be a request to investigate the golden city.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001230_ERENVILLE
126.description: A request to investigate the golden city...from the Dawnservant himself?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001240_WUKLAMAT
127.description: Well, well... Seems it may be more than a rumor after all.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001250_KRILE
128.description: Being a member of the royal family, it was my hope that you could confirm the authenticity of this letter.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001260_WUKLAMAT
129.description: I can say for a fact that my father didn't write this.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001270_WUKLAMAT
130.description: Given how culturally diverse Tuliyollal is, it was decided some time ago that a common language was needed.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001280_WUKLAMAT
131.description: But instead of elevating an existing tongue, and its speakers, above all others, we looked to those widely spoken overseas and created an altogether new one.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001290_WUKLAMAT
132.description: These similarities to your common tongue also make it quite easy to communicate in these situations, no?

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001300_WUKLAMAT
133.description: This letter, however, is entirely in Eorzean. If Father had written this, it would have been in Turali.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001310_WUKLAMAT
134.description: What's more, it bears a wax seal. We don't bother with them.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001320_KRILE
135.description: So the letter is fraudulent, then?

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001330_WUKLAMAT
136.description: Oh, I didn't mean to say that. My father's signature is genuine, as far as I can tell, so perhaps he simply dictated it.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001340_KRILE
137.description: I see... Thank you for the confirmation. It seems my grandfather indeed had dealings with Tuliyollal.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001350_KRILE
138.description: I can't help but be curious as to what exactly he was doing there.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001360_KRILE
139.description: In order to help us decide on a course of action, would you mind if I asked you some questions about your home?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001380_WUKLAMAT
141.description: After all, learning about one another was the purpose of this hunt.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001390_WUKLAMAT
142.description: We can talk while feasting on this fellow. I for one am starving!

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001410_WUKLAMAT
144.description: Come, come, let's enjoy the bounty of our first outing together!

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001420_WUKLAMAT
146.description: I'd heard that Sharlayan cuisine was terrible, but this is fantastic!

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001440_WUKLAMAT
148.description: Oh come now, since when did you become so soft? It's not like we don't have spicy food in Tural too!

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001450_GRAHATIA
149.description: According to Dickon, intensely hot dishes have become popular in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han after a traveler ordered a curry with several times the usual amount of spice.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001460_GRAHATIA
150.description: So he started offering the same in order to please the growing Hannish population here in Sharlayan.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001490_ERENVILLE
153.description: Your boorish manners reflect poorly on the both of us. I wish you would consider your station...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001500_WUKLAMAT
154.description: I swear, sometimes it feels like you open your mouth only to criticize.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001510_GRAHATIA
155.description: Would I be correct in assuming you've known each other for a long time?

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001520_WUKLAMAT
156.description: Aye. Thick as thieves since we were little.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001530_ERENVILLE
157.description: I beg to differ. She is a long-standing acquaintance, nothing more.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001550_KRILE
160.description: All this time, you were from Tural? Would that I had known sooner. There's so much I'd like to ask...

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001560_ERENVILLE
161.description: You and everyone else. I've kept it quiet so as to avoid the endless interrogations.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001570_WUKLAMAT
162.description: Well, if he's going to be a miser, I'll be happy to tell you about our homeland instead.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001580_WUKLAMAT
163.description: Since ancient times, many peoples have called Tural home, and they've been fighting each other for nearly as long.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001590_WUKLAMAT
164.description: The fighting finally stopped some eighty years ago, when the reigning Dawnservant unified the disparate communities and founded a new nation.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001600_GRAHATIA
165.description: And that's how Tuliyollal came to be...

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001610_WUKLAMAT
166.description: Since then, we've enjoyed an era of uninterrupted peace.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001620_WUKLAMAT
167.description: But my father is getting old, and he wishes to relinquish the throne to a worthy successor─one who can preserve his legacy.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001630_WUKLAMAT
168.description: Including myself, there are four claimants to the throne. But while we all have the right to participate, one among us cannot be allowed to rule.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001640_ERENVILLE
169.description: A man who is too ambitious by half.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001650_ERENVILLE
170.description: Word of the Garlean Empire's collapse has reached Tural.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001660_ERENVILLE
171.description: While most are simply relieved, he sees weakness to exploit, and would lead our armies across the seas on a campaign of conquest.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001670_WUKLAMAT
172.description: After everything my father has done to give us peace, he would drag us back into war.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001690_WUKLAMAT
174.description: No matter what, I must win this contest!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001700_GRAHATIA
175.description: I understand your reasons, but this being an event that will dictate the course of your nation's future, is it appropriate for outsiders like us to be involved?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001710_WUKLAMAT
176.description: Oh, it's more than appropriate. The Dawnservant himself expressly encourages it.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001720_WUKLAMAT
177.description: The ruler of Tural must navigate the intricacies of myriad cultures, and there's no better way to prove oneself qualified to do so than to work with foreign allies.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001730_WUKLAMAT
178.description: That's why I sought you out. Through our hunt, I've confirmed that you're a warrior of considerable skill. But more importantly, one of good character as well.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001740_WUKLAMAT
179.description: And so I ask you: will you lend me your strength, and help me win the throne of Tuliyollal?

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001750_WUKLAMAT
180.description: You don't need to decide right this moment.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001760_WUKLAMAT
181.description: But I will need you if I'm to triumph over the competition. I'll stay here as long as I can while waiting for your answer.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001770_KRILE
182.description: In that case, allow us to prepare a room for you at the Baldesion Annex.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001790_WUKLAMAT
184.description: Oh, and one more thing... Once we've finished eating, would you mind if I took the rest of the meat?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001800_GRAHATIA
185.description: Oh, it's just... Despite all that we've learned, I can't help but feel we've yet to hear the whole story...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001810_GRAHATIA
186.description: What about you, my friend? Are you inclined to accept or refuse Wuk Lamat's request?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
188.description: I never say no to a new adventure!

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
189.description: I'm still undecided, to be honest.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
190.description: I'd rather not get involved in politics.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001820_GRAHATIA
191.description: Hah, I thought you might say that.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001830_GRAHATIA
192.description: With an intrepid attitude such as yours, I believe all shall be well.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001840_GRAHATIA
193.description: Be it the contest or something else, there will be many trials for you to overcome at your destination.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001850_GRAHATIA
194.description: But in the course of seeing new lands and meeting new people, you'll surely find a way forward. That's what adventurers do, is it not?

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001860_GRAHATIA
195.description: I don't blame you. No matter the assurances, it's no simple thing to wade into the midst of a political struggle, and in a foreign land at that.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001870_GRAHATIA
196.description: How about this, then. Instead of deciding here, go there first and then decide.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001880_GRAHATIA
197.description: In the course of seeing new lands and meeting new people, you'll surely find a way forward.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001890_GRAHATIA
198.description: That's what adventurers do, is it not?

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001900_GRAHATIA
199.description: If only others had the same good sense.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001910_GRAHATIA
200.description: If the prospect troubles you so, why not consider what you stand to gain instead? That is, an exciting journey to a faraway continent.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001920_GRAHATIA
201.description: In the course of seeing new lands and meeting new people, you might find yourself moved to help Wuk Lamat after all. And if not, well...you quietly take your leave.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001930_GRAHATIA
202.description: A brazen plan, perhaps, but one that befits a veteran adventurer, you must agree!

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001940_GRAHATIA
203.description: Such a journey would be the envy of many a scholar. Distant as it is, Tural remains largely unknown to us, with only meager records to be found in Noumenon.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001950_GRAHATIA
204.description: The experiences to be had─all the things you might hear, feel, and think... It's enough to stir me to the core.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001960_GRAHATIA
205.description: Life is a series of journeys, my friend, and there's no telling what awaits us on the long road.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001970_GRAHATIA
206.description: But what's important is to be true to yourself as you walk it.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_001980_GRAHATIA
207.description: Only then can we hope to be content when we arrive at the end of one─and step forward into another.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002000_GRAHATIA
209.description: I have a matter to attend to at the Agora. Please go on inside─I will join you shortly.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002010_WUKLAMAT
210.description: You have the look of someone who's made up their mind. Go on then, let's hear it.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
212.description: I wish to boldly go where I've never gone before!

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
213.description: I've never been one to turn down an adventure. I'll do it.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002030_WUKLAMAT
215.description: Then you need me as much as I need you. Together, we'll blaze new trails in Tural!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002050_WUKLAMAT
217.description: Excellent! You'll be compensated for your troubles, of course, but I daresay your time in Tural will be its own reward!

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002060_ALISAIE
218.description: You're not planning to leave without us, are you?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002070_KRILE
219.description: Alphinaud! Alisaie! What are you two doing here?

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002080_GRAHATIA
220.description: We happened to cross paths at Noumenon earlier, you see, and I told them about Wuk Lamat.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002090_GRAHATIA
221.description: And when we fortuitously met again at the Agora just now, they expressed an interest in meeting our visitor.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002100_WUKLAMAT
222.description: Ah, you must be the twins who were sneaking after Erenville as toads!

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002110_ALISAIE
223.description: A hundred things about us you could have told her, and you chose that!?

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002130_ALPHINAUD
225.description: 'Tis an honor and a pleasure to make your acquaintance, Your Highness. Alphinaud Leveilleur, at your service, and this is my sister, Alisaie.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002140_WUKLAMAT
226.description: Oh, no, let's not do that. I really can't stand titles.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002150_WUKLAMAT
227.description: So. You want to participate in the contest too, is that right?

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002170_ALPHINAUD
229.description: We've been assisting with the rebuilding effort in Garlemald. Yet while progress is being made, the question remains of how the nation might reconcile with its neighbors.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002180_ALPHINAUD
230.description: We believe there is much we might learn from Tuliyollal, a nation founded on unity. And in return for this honor, we would spare no effort in supporting your claim.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002190_WUKLAMAT
231.description: The more the merrier, I say. And I'd be keen to learn about Eorzea and Garlemald from you as well.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002200_ERENVILLE
232.description: Having recruited so many committed and capable allies, I presume you have no need for my continued assistance.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002210_WUKLAMAT
233.description: Nonsense! Like I told you before, you're indispensable.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002220_WUKLAMAT
234.description: They're strong, aye, but strangers to our land. They need someone to guide them─to point out the dangers and spare them grisly deaths.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002230_WUKLAMAT
235.description: I can't think of anyone better suited to that task than you. What's more, despite your assertions, I know you haven't given up on the city of gold.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002240_GRAHATIA
236.description: As I recall, Krile, you were the first to state your desire to visit Tural.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002260_KRILE
238.description: Still, I can't help but worry about being away just when our order is beginning to find its feet again.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002270_GRAHATIA
239.description: You have nothing to worry about.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002280_GRAHATIA
240.description: I haven't forgotten how you held the fort while I set off to explore Alzadaal's Legacy; it's only fair that I return the favor. Pray leave the Students to Ojika and me.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002300_GRAHATIA
242.description: You want to retrace your grandfather's steps, don't you? This is a rare opportunity, and I insist that you seize it!

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002320_WUKLAMAT
244.description: Well, looks like it's settled! I'm counting on you all to help me win the throne!

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002330_GRAHATIA
245.description: I suppose now is a good time to show you what I spent a small fortune on at the Agora.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002350_GRAHATIA
247.description: This, my friends, is the latest map of the world, created to celebrate our friendship with the Loporrits. Cast your eyes west of Sharlayan, for there it lies...

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002355_GRAHATIA
248.description: The site of your next great adventure─Tural!

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002370_ESTINIEN
250.description: When does the next ship set sail?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002390_ESTINIEN
252.description: The north and east, I've already seen...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002400_ESTINIEN
253.description: I suppose I'll head west this time.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002430_THANCRED
256.description: I see you've made up your mind. I had a feeling you'd be keen.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002440_URIANGER
257.description: But to think that our comrades, too, are thither bound... Fate doth work in mysterious ways.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002450_URIANGER
258.description: But to think that our comrades, too, are thither bound... Fate doth work in mysterious ways.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002460_THANCRED
259.description: Indeed. It will be a grueling task, having to contend with them.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002470_URIANGER
260.description: If the prospect doth trouble thee, 'tis not too late to decline the petition.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002480_URIANGER
261.description: ...Though thine expression would suggest thou art far from perturbed.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002490_THANCRED
262.description: Oh, how could I possibly be, knowing what's to come?

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002500_URIANGER
264.description: Then let us delay no further, and secure passage on a vessel.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002510_THANCRED
265.description: Aye, this will be a mission to remember.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002520_THANCRED
266.description: Come, my friend! We make for Tural!

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002530_EMETSELCH
267.description: (-Emet-Selch-)Tell me, have you been to the ruins beneath the waters of the Bounty?

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002540_EMETSELCH
268.description: (-Emet-Selch-)Or the treasure islands beyond the frozen waters of Blindfrost, in Othard's north?

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06505_002550_EMETSELCH
269.description: (-Emet-Selch-)The fabled golden cities of the New World?
